blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the chemical composition of a chromosome. Explain the levels of organization by which DNA is packed into a chromatid. (4 marks)
(Chromosome ki kimiyai banawat bayan karein. Un darjon ki wazahat karein jin se DNA chromatid mein band hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Kimiyai banawat: chromosome 40% DNA aur 60% proteins (histones) se bana hai. Dono chromatids ki DNA aik jaisi hai. Aam insani chromosome ki DNA taqreeban 5 cm lambi aur taqreeban 140 million nucleotides ki hai. DNA negative (phosphate groups) aur histones positive (arginine, lysine ki kasrat) hain, is liye DNA histones se mazbooti se jurti hai.

Tanzeem ke darje:
1. Nucleosome string: taqreeban har 146 nucleotides ki DNA (2 nm) histone octamer (H2A, H2B, H3, H4 ki do do copies) ke gird do dafa lipat kar nucleosome banati hai. Nucleosomes taqreeban 80 nucleotides ki linker DNA se jure hain; linker histone H1 DNA ke dakhil/kharij hone ki jagah par hota hai aur lipatne mein madad deta hai. Nucleosomes dhaage par motiyon jaise lagte hain: nucleosome string (11 nm).
2. Chromatin fibre: cell division ke shuru mein nucleosome string apne mehwar par dobara lipat-ti hai; ghane nucleosomes chromatin fibre (30 nm) banate hain.
3. Supercoil aur chromatid: chromatin fibre khud par tah ho kar supercoil (300 nm) banati hai, jo mazeed lipat kar chromatid (700 nm) ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The following are the levels of the organization of chromosomes

blocks.prompt:
2 A genetic material must have certain characteristics. (i) State these characteristics. (ii) Explain how Avery, MacLeod and McCarty identified the transforming principle. (4 marks)
(Genetic material mein kuch khasiyat honi chahiye. (i) Yeh khasiyat bayan karein. (ii) Wazahat karein ke Avery, MacLeod aur McCarty ne transforming principle kaise pehchana.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Genetic material ki khasiyat:
1. Proteins mein amino acids ki tarteeb ka code de sake.
2. Cell division se pehle apni copy bana sake.
3. Eukaryotic cells ke nucleus mein ho.
4. Waqt ke saath badal sake taa ke evolution ho.
Sirf DNA yeh sab poora karti hai.

(ii) Avery, MacLeod aur McCarty (1944):
1. Unhon ne maare gaye S-type se proteins nikal kar zinda R-type ke saath milaye. Is mixture se chuhe bimar hue aur un mein zinda S-type mile, yani proteins R-type ko S-type mein nahin badalte.
2. Phir unhon ne maare S-type se saari DNA nikal kar zinda R-type ke saath mila kar inject kiya. Transformation nahin hui aur chuhe sehatmand rahe.
Natija: DNA hi transforming principle ki bunyadi ikai hai.

book_ref.quote: Only one molecule i.e., DNA fulfils all these requirements

blocks.prompt:
4 Radio-isotopes are used to trace DNA in experiments. (i) What is a pulse-chase experiment? (ii) How did Meselson and Stahl prepare heavy DNA and separate DNA molecules of different densities? (4 marks)
(Tajarbon mein DNA ka pata lagane ke liye radio-isotopes istemal hote hain. (i) Pulse-chase experiment kya hai? (ii) Meselson aur Stahl ne bhari DNA kaise tayyar ki aur mukhtalif density wali DNA kaise alag ki?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Pulse-chase experiment: woh tajarba jis mein radio-isotope wali DNA ko organism ki aulad mein talash kiya jata hai. Is ke do stages hain:
1. Pulse: organism ko thori der radio-isotope diya jata hai aur woh use DNA mein shamil karta hai.
2. Chase: nishaan wali DNA ko radioactivity naap kar waqt ke saath dekha jata hai.

(ii) Meselson aur Stahl:
1. Unhon ne bacteria ko bhari isotope ¹⁵N wale medium mein ugaya; kayi naslon baad DNA ki nitrogen bases mein ¹⁵N tha aur woh aam se ghani thi.
2. Phir in bacteria ko ¹⁴N medium mein dala taa ke nayi DNA ¹⁴N se bane, aur 0, 20 aur 40 minute par DNA jama ki.
3. DNA ko cesium chloride ke mehlool mein hal kar ke ultracentrifuge kiya; is se cesium ki density ka gradient bana (ghana cesium neeche).
4. Har DNA wahan thehri jahan us ki density cesium ke barabar thi; bhari ¹⁵N DNA halki ¹⁴N DNA se zyada neeche gayi.

book_ref.quote: They checked heavier DNA (with ¹⁵N) and lighter DNA (with ¹⁴N)

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the roles of the enzymes and proteins that work in DNA replication in prokaryotes. (4 marks)
(Prokaryotes mein DNA replication mein kaam karne wale enzymes aur proteins ke kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Initiator protein: replication origin site se jur kar amal shuru karti hai.
2. Helicases: kholne wale enzymes jo base-pairs ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds tor kar do replication forks (replication bubble) banate hain.
3. Gyrase (topoisomerase): fork ke aage jur kar kholne se bane supercoils ko rokta hai.
4. Single-strand binding proteins: akeli strands se jur kar unhein dobara jurne aur lipatne se rokti hain.
5. Primase: origin par har template strand ke saamne 5-10 RNA nucleotides ka primer lagata hai.
6. DNA polymerase III: bunyadi enzyme; azad nucleotides ko template se milata hai (A ke saath T, C ke saath G), sirf 3′ sire par, 5′ se 3′ simt mein; musalsal leading strand aur lagging strand ke Okazaki fragments banata hai aur proofreading karta hai.
7. DNA polymerase I: khatme par RNA primers nikal kar khali jagah (Okazaki fragments ke darmiyan bhi) DNA nucleotides se bharta hai.
8. DNA ligase: lagging strand ke Okazaki fragments jorta hai.
(DNA polymerase II cell ki zindagi mein DNA ke nuqsan ki marammat karta hai.)

book_ref.quote: The enzyme gyrase (or topoisomerase) attaches ahead of the replication fork

blocks.prompt:
7 Replicating DNA has two important properties. (i) Explain the stability and variability of DNA. (ii) Describe how biotechnologists use DNA replication. (4 marks)
(Replicate hoti DNA ki do ahem khasiyat hain. (i) DNA ki stability aur variability ki wazahat karein. (ii) Biotechnologists DNA replication ko kaise istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Stability: DNA ka durusti se copy hona. DNA polymerase III (aur eukaryotic polymerases) ki proofreading sequence ko barqarar rakhti hai; is se organism ke khaas traits qaim rehte hain aur cells sahi kaam karte hain.
Variability istisna hai: kabhi DNA sequence mein mustaqil tabdeeli, yani mutation, ho jati hai, replication ki ghalti ya mahol ki wajah se. Variability naye traits ka bunyadi zariya hai; is se populations badalte mahol mein dhalti hain aur yeh evolution ka kham maal hai.

(ii) DNA replication ke istemal:
1. PCR: kisi khaas DNA ki arbon copies banai jati hain.
2. Recombinant DNA technology: mukhtalif zariyon se kaati DNA ko replicate kar ke barhaya jata hai.
3. Genome sequencing: genome ki kayi copies bana kar sequence maloom ki jati hai.
4. Diagnostic studies: mareez ki DNA ke khaas hisse replicate kar ke mutations dhoondi jati hain taa ke genetic bimari ka pata chale.

book_ref.quote: These are two important properties of a replicating DNA

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe how the genetic code was worked out by Francis Crick, Marshall Nirenberg, Philip Leder and Har Gobind Khorana. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke Francis Crick, Marshall Nirenberg, Philip Leder aur Har Gobind Khorana ne genetic code kaise maloom kiya.)
blocks.explanation:
Francis Crick (1961): unhon ne aur saathiyon ne kaha ke genetic code codons ke silsile par mushtamil hai, har codon aik amino acid tay karta hai. Akele nucleotides sirf 4, aur 2 nucleotides wale codons sirf 16 (4 × 4) amino acids ka code dete. Is liye codon 3 nucleotides ka hona chahiye: 4 nucleotides 64 (4 × 4 × 4) triplets dete hain, jo 20 amino acids ke liye kaafi se zyada hain. Code triplet hai; DNA ke codons mRNA par complementary codons bante hain (DNA ka TAC = mRNA ka AUG).

Marshall Nirenberg (1961): unhon ne poly-U mRNA (sirf uracil) bana kar bacteria ke cytoplasm mein dali; bohat se phenylalanine wali polypeptide bani, is liye UUU phenylalanine ka codon hai.

Nirenberg aur Philip Leder ne tamam triplets parkhe aur 47 codons ke amino acids maloom kiye. Har Gobind Khorana (Government College, Lahore ke talib-e-ilm) ne baqi 17 maloom kiye.

Natija: 64 codons mein UGA, UAG aur UAA stop (nonsense) codons hain aur AUG start codon hai jo methionine deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Nirenberg and another American geneticist Philip Leder tested all triplet codons

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the characteristics of the genetic code. (4 marks)
(Genetic code ki khasiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Universal: code taqreeban tamam organisms mein aik jaisa hai; maslan AGA bacteria, insanon aur sab mein arginine hai, is liye genes organisms mein muntaqil ho sakte hain. Istisna: mitochondria ki DNA ka code thora mukhtalif hai (un ki alag evolutionary tareekh), aur kuch ciliates aur viruses mukhtalif codes istemal karte hain.
2. Triplet: har codon teen nucleotides ki sequence hai, is liye DNA ki maloomat 20 qisam ke amino acids ke liye kaafi hai.
3. Degenerate: kayi codons aik hi amino acid de sakte hain, maslan GUU, GUC, GUA aur GUG sab valine. Yeh mutation bardasht karne aur evolutionary lachak ke liye ahem hai.
4. Waqfon ke baghair: codon musalsal parha jata hai, us ke teen nucleotides ke darmiyan koi gap nahin.
5. Non-overlapping: har triplet saath wale codons se alag parha jata hai; AUGAGCGCA sirf AUG/AGC/GCA parha jata hai, AUG/UGA/GAG nahin.

book_ref.quote: Characteristic is important for mutation tolerance and evolutionary flexibility

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Degeneracy ki book wali misaal (AUG, GUG, UUG, CUG sab methionine) ghalat hai; methionine ka sirf AUG hai. Sahi misaal valine ke chaar codons GUU, GUC, GUA, GUG hain.

blocks.prompt:
10 Transcription begins when RNA polymerase binds a promoter. (i) Name the promoters of prokaryotes and eukaryotes with their positions. (ii) Describe the subunits of RNA polymerase and how the transcription bubble is formed. (4 marks)
(Transcription tab shuru hoti hai jab RNA polymerase promoter se jurta hai. (i) Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes ke promoters un ki jagah ke saath batayein. (ii) RNA polymerase ki subunits aur transcription bubble banne ka amal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Promoter template DNA par nucleotides ki khaas sequence hai jahan RNA polymerase jurta hai; yeh khud transcribe nahin hota (primer ki zaroorat nahin).
Prokaryotes: TTGACA, start point se 35 nucleotides pehle (–35 sequence); TATAAT, 10 nucleotides pehle (–10 sequence).
Eukaryotes: TATAAA (TATA box), 25 nucleotides pehle (–25 sequence); GGCCAATCT (CAAT box), 70 nucleotides pehle (–70 sequence).

(ii) RNA polymerase ki paanch subunits:
1. Do α subunits regulatory proteins se jurti hain.
2. β′ subunit template DNA se jurti hai.
3. β subunit RNA nucleotides se jurti hai.
4. σ subunit promoter pehchanti aur amal shuru karti hai.
Promoter se jurne par σ subunit hat jati hai. Baqi chaar subunits (core enzyme) DNA helix kholti aur base-pairs torti hain, jis se bulbule jaisi structure, transcription bubble, banti hai jis mein RNA chain banti hai.

book_ref.quote: RNA polymerase consists of five subunits

blocks.prompt:
12 Translation needs activated amino acids and a ribosome. (i) What is the activation of amino acids? (ii) Describe the initiation complex and the three sites of the ribosome. (4 marks)
(Translation ke liye activated amino acids aur ribosome chahiye. (i) Amino acids ki activation kya hai? (ii) Initiation complex aur ribosome ki teen sites bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Amino acids ki activation: protein banne se pehle khaas tRNAs khaas amino acids se jur kar aminoacyl-tRNAs (aa-tRNA) banate hain. Yeh enzyme aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase karta hai; is ki 20 qismein hain, har aik khaas amino acid se jurti aur us ke anticodon wale tRNA ko pehchanti hai. aa-tRNA amino acid ribosome tak le jata hai.

(ii) Initiation complex: pehle amino acid wala aa-tRNA chhoti ribosomal subunit se jurta hai (initiation factor control karta hai); doosra initiation factor mRNA ka 5′ sira chhoti subunit se jorta aur anticodon ko pehle codon (AUG) par rakhta hai; phir bari subunit upar lagti hai. Complex dono subunits, pehle aa-tRNA, mRNA aur enzyme par mushtamil hai.
Ribosome ki sites:
1. P site: jahan amino acids ke darmiyan peptide bonds bante hain; pehla aa-tRNA yahan hota hai.
2. A site: jahan agla aa-tRNA jurta hai.
3. E site: jahan se khali tRNAs nikalte hain.
mRNA ke lihaz se 5′ se 3′ tarteeb E-P-A hai kyun ke ribosome 3′ sire ki taraf chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The aa-tRNA delivers the amino acid to the ribosome for incorporation into the polypeptide chain

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the roles of the enzymes and protein factors that work during translation. (4 marks)
(Translation ke dauran kaam karne wale enzymes aur protein factors ke kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase (20 qismein): har khaas amino acid ko us ke tRNA se jor kar aa-tRNA banata hai (amino acids ki activation).
2. Initiation factors: aik pehle aa-tRNA ke chhoti subunit se jurne ko control karta hai; doosra mRNA ka 5′ sira chhoti subunit se jor kar anticodon ko start codon AUG par rakhta hai.
3. Elongation factor: milte anticodon wale agle aa-tRNA ko A site se jurne mein madad deta hai.
4. Peptidyl transferase: P site ke tRNA se amino acid (pehli dafa methionine) utar kar A site ke amino acid se peptide bond se jorta hai. Phir ribosome teen nucleotides aage barhta hai (translocation); yeh qadam stop codon ke A site par aane tak dohraye jate hain.
5. Release factor: protein jo A site par stop codon pehchan kar P site ke tRNA se polypeptide alag karti hai; tRNA nikal jata hai aur subunits mRNA se alag ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: These steps are repeated again and again until the stop codon is reached at A site

blocks.prompt:
14 Gene expression is regulated in many ways. (i) At which levels is gene expression regulated? (ii) Explain how genes are regulated during splicing. (4 marks)
(Gene expression kayi tareeqon se regulate hoti hai. (i) Gene expression kin darjon par regulate hoti hai? (ii) Splicing ke dauran genes kaise regulate hote hain, wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Gene expression kayi darjon par regulate hoti hai:
1. Transcription level: transcription ki raftar (regulatory proteins genes ki regulatory sequences se jurti hain; repressors operators se jur kar RNA polymerase rokte hain, activators RNA polymerase ko promoter se jurne mein madad dete hain).
2. Post-transcriptional level: mRNA ki tabdeeli control hoti hai.
3. Translation level: translation ki raftar.
4. Post-translational level: protein ki tabdeeli (folding, stability waghera).

(ii) Splicing ke dauran regulation: eukaryotes mein mRNA cytoplasm bhejne se pehle badli jati hai. Splicing (introns nikalna aur exons jorna) ke dauran genes ON ya OFF ho sakte hain. Khaas cells ki khaas regulatory proteins splicing control karti hain aur mRNA ke hisse (introns ya exons) mukhtalif tareeqon se nikalti hain, is liye mukhtalif lambai ki mRNAs banti hain. Natija: aik gene se aik se zyada polypeptides (alternate splicing).

book_ref.quote: These proteins remove the pieces of mRNA (introns or exons) in different ways

blocks.prompt:
15 Define mutation. Explain natural and induced mutations, and how mutations contribute to evolution. (4 marks)
(Mutation ki definition likhein. Natural aur induced mutations aur evolution mein mutations ke hisse ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mutation: genetic paigham ke mawad mein tabdeeli. Yeh chhoti (aik ya chand nucleotides) ya bari (bara hissa ya poora chromosome) ho sakti hai. Mutation paida karne wale agents mutagens hain; jis organism ya cell mein mutation ho woh mutant hai.

Natural mutations khud ba khud hoti hain, replication mein sequence ki ghalti ya DNA ke nuqsan se. Yeh evolution ka hissa hain aur faidemand, be-asar ya nuqsandeh ho sakti hain.
Induced mutations bairooni asbaab se hoti hain: mutagen substances, radiation, mahol ke chemicals (kuch pesticides, sanati aloodgi) ya chemotherapy jaisa ilaj. In ke sehat par sangeen asar ho sakte hain.

Mutations aur evolution: mutation aur recombination tamam genetic variation ke aakhri zariye hain. Yeh naye DNA sequences (alleles) aur un ke combinations banate hain, jin se faidemand, nuqsandeh ya be-asar traits bante hain. Natural selection in par amal karta hai aur faidemand alleles ki frequency barhti hai, jis se lambe arse mein evolution hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Induced mutations are caused by external factors such as exposure to mutagen substances or radiation

blocks.prompt:
16 Explain silent, missense and nonsense mutations with one example of each. (4 marks)
(Silent, missense aur nonsense mutations ki har aik ki misaal ke saath wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Silent mutations: protein ki amino acid tarteeb nahin badalti. Genetic code ki degeneracy ki wajah se badla hua codon wahi amino acid deta hai. Misaal: mRNA codon GGC ka GGU ban jana; dono glycine dete hain.

2. Missense mutations: sirf aik amino acid badalta hai jo protein ke kaam par asar dal sakta hai. Misaal: haemoglobin gene mein aik nucleotide ki tabdeeli (A se T) se glutamic acid ki jagah valine aata hai; RBCs gol shakal kho dete hain aur sickle cell anaemia hoti hai.

3. Nonsense mutations: waqt se pehle stop codon banta hai, jis se chhoti be-kaar proteins banti hain. Misaal: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy mein gene ke beech mein waqt se pehle stop signal banta hai; chhoti protein kaam nahin karti aur pathe dheere dheere kamzor hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These mutations create a premature stop codon in the protein sequence

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book GGC se GGU ko "DNA code" kehti hai, magar U sirf RNA mein hota hai; GGC aur GGU mRNA codons hain (DNA coding strand par GGC se GGT).

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the possible ways to treat genetic diseases. (4 marks)
(Genetic bimariyon ke ilaj ke mumkina tareeqe bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Gene therapy: badle hue gene ko durust karna ya kaam karne wale gene se badalna.
2. Cell therapy: kaam na karne wale cells ko transplant se sehatmand cells se badalna. Maslan type 1 diabetes mein insulin banane wale pancreatic beta cells kaam nahin karte; cell therapy unhein sehatmand cells se badalti hai.
3. Pharmacogenomics: dawa ka ilaj insaan ki genetic banawat ke mutabiq; mareez ki DNA dekh kar doctor us ke liye behtareen dawa chunte hain.
4. Genetic counselling: jin ke khandan mein genetic bimariyan hon unhein maloomat aur madad, jis mein genetic testing, bimari ki taleem aur family planning aur aulad ke options ki rehnumai shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: Possible ways to treat genetic diseases

(Point mutations se hone wali bimariyon sickle cell anaemia aur phenylketonuria ka muwazna karein.)

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe the changes in chromosome structure: chromosomal rearrangements and insertional inactivation. (4 marks)
(Chromosome ki banawat mein tabdeeliyan bayan karein: chromosomal rearrangements aur insertional inactivation.)
blocks.explanation:
Chromosomal mutations bare paimane ki mutations hain jin mein genes ki jagah ya chromosomes ki banawat ya tadaad badalti hai; yeh aam tor par khud ba khud hoti hain.

1. Chromosomal rearrangements: chromosomes mein jismani tabdeeliyan, maslan deletions, duplications, inversions aur translocations. Aam tor par yeh DNA double helix ke do mukhtalif jagah tootne se hoti hain.
- Translocation: aik chromosome ka tukra doosre chromosome ka hissa ban jata hai.
- Inversion: chromosome ke aik hisse ka rukh ulat jata hai.

2. Insertional inactivation: chromosomes ke chhote tukre, transposons ya jumping genes, genome mein aik jagah se doosri jagah ittefaqan jate hain. Kuch genes mein ghus kar unhein be-kaar kar dete hain. Yeh qudrat mein aam hai aur bohat si insani bimariyan isi se hain. Misaal: insani transposon X chromosome ke clotting factor IX gene mein ghus kar beech mein stop codon laga deta hai, jis se X-linked haemophilia hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Chromosomal Rearrangements: Chromosomes can undergo physical alterations

blocks.prompt:
20 What is non-disjunction? Explain how non-disjunction of sex chromosomes produces XXY, XXX, XO and OY zygotes, and the fate of each. (4 marks)
(Non-disjunction kya hai? Wazahat karein ke sex chromosomes ke non-disjunction se XXY, XXX, XO aur OY zygotes kaise bante hain aur har aik ka anjaam kya hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Non-disjunction: kabhi meiosis mein chromatids sahi alag nahin hote, is liye gamete mein aik chromosome zyada ya kam ho jata hai. Aisa gamete zygote banaye to shadeed nuqs ho sakte hain. Yeh autosomes ya sex chromosomes mein ho sakta hai.

Maan mein X ke non-disjunction se eggs mein XX ya koi sex chromosome nahin (O) hota hai:
1. XX egg + aam Y sperm → XXY (47; 44+XXY): Klinefelter syndrome, banjh mard. XXY tab bhi banta hai jab XY sperm (baap mein non-disjunction) aam X egg se mile.
2. XX egg + X sperm → XXX (47): triple X syndrome, fertile larki jis mein seekhne ki mushkilat, lamba qad aur door door aankhein.
3. O egg + aam X sperm (ya O sperm + aam X egg) → XO (45; 44+XO): Turner syndrome, banjh larki (sex chromosomes ki monosomy).
4. O egg + aam Y sperm → OY: zygote nahin barhta, kyun ke insaan X chromosome ke genes ke baghair zinda nahin reh sakta.

book_ref.quote: the egg may have both X chromosomes (XX) or may have no sex chromosome (designated as O)

blocks.prompt:
21 Abnormal chromosome numbers have different causes and outcomes. (i) Why is the age of the mother more critical than that of the father for non-disjunction? (ii) What is the fate of zygotes with one less or one extra autosome? (4 marks)
(Chromosomes ki ghair-mamooli tadaad ki wajah aur anjaam mukhtalif hain. (i) Non-disjunction ke liye maan ki umar baap se zyada ahem kyun hai? (ii) Aik autosome kam ya zyada wale zygotes ka anjaam kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Non-disjunction ka eggs mein waqt ke saath jama hona sperm se kahin zyada mumkin hai. Tamam aainda eggs larki ki paidaish tak prophase I tak pohanch chuke hote hain, is liye jab woh maan banti hai to us ke eggs us jitne purane hote hain. Mard rozana naye sperm banate hain. Is liye maan ki umar zyada ahem hai.

(ii) Aik autosome kam wala zygote nashonuma poori nahin kar sakta. Zaid autosome wale zyada tar zygotes bhi zinda nahin rehte. Magar jore 13, 15, 18, 21 aur 22 mein teen chromosomes ho sakte hain aur insaan kuch arsa zinda reh sakta hai:
- Jore 13, 15 ya 18 mein zaid chromosome se shadeed nuqs hote hain; aise bache chand mahinon mein mar jate hain.
- Zaid chromosome 21 ya 22 wale aam tor par jawani tak zinda rehte hain, magar dhanche ki pukhtagi der se hoti hai, is liye chhote qad aur kamzor pathon wale hote hain aur zehni nashonuma mutasir hoti hai (maslan Down syndrome, trisomy 21).

book_ref.quote: If a zygote receives one less autosome, it cannot complete development

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book ki list "13, 15, 18, 21, and 2" mein aakhri jora 22 hai (book correction); chromosome 2 ki trisomy zinda rehne ke qabil nahin.
